name: TAXUS BACCATA
key_symptoms: Saliva hot, acrid. Nausea. Pain in pit of stomach and region of navel. After eating, cough. Feeling of pins and needles at pit of stomach; of emptiness, must eat frequently (compare the coniferć).
Supra-orbital and temporal pain on right side, with lachrymation. Pupils dilated. Face puffy and pale.
